channelIntro.title: Why would you hide or restrict a question?
channelIntro.body1: "Visible on the listing page" shows the question on the venue's page and in the structured data (JSON-LD) search engines read. "Usable by AI" lets the chat assistant use this question to answer guest queries.
channelIntro.body2: Uncheck "Visible on the listing page" for information that's useful to know but that you don't want published: something temporary, a margin you'd rather not promise in writing, or a tip that reads better in a conversation than on the storefront.
channelIntro.body3: Uncheck "Usable by AI" for content you want shown exactly as written, without the assistant rephrasing it.
channelIntro.body4: Important: a question that isn't visible on the listing but is usable by AI is not private. The assistant can still say it to anyone who asks in chat; it just won't be published on the page.
